summary: Plays the AdLib soundtracks of several early-1990s DOS games through an OPL2 chip emulation, and doubles as a tracker for editing and writing songs in the original .CMF format.
features: 18 built-in DOS game songs, played as the original sound driver did
Tracker editor with song order and OPL2 instrument screens; 32-step undo
Nine flash slots saving plain .CMF files the original driver can play
Scope screen with nine channel oscilloscopes and per-channel mutes
Arpeggiator synced to the song's rows, writable into the tracker
Includes an experimental WiFi diagnostics page; no song export to a computer yet

headings: oplbox — the m-vave fm-1 as an adlib
